caption: The drawing depicts a metallic wall-mounted object consisting mainly of a cylindrical container with a rounded bottom and a fitted dome-shaped lid, both rendered in shades of gray. Attached to the container are two spouts or nozzles, positioned next to each other on the top side of the lid, also shaded in gray. The container is supported by a flat, circular backing plate with a raised concentric circle design, attached to the wall via a large ring at its top. A bracket, also rendered in gray, extends from the backing plate to support the main container, forming a circular loop around its middle. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset outline drawing of the same object, labeled with measurements indicating the container’s dimensions as 6 1/4 inches tall, 8 1/4 inches wide, and the backing plate’s diameter as 6 1/4 inches. The signature “A. Maralian” is present at the bottom right corner of the main drawing. The background is plain, and the overall composition is monochrome with shading to provide a three-dimensional effect.
title: Lamp
